summary: Verified the tz_aware MongoClient fix for the 'False Negative Missing BOMs' bug. Confirmed backend restarted with fix (uptime ~10min, prior 'can't compare offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes' errors only found in log entries timestamped BEFORE the restart). Generated a full live Purchasing Plan end-to-end (job completed in ~7 min), confirmed FMF519/HTBS/NS-SPST2B are correctly resolved (not in missing_boms), total components = 799 (exact match to expected post-fix count), missing_boms count = 8 with exactly the expected legitimate list (7721622, 7770570, P392619, P392622, P392623, P392638, P392639, WMN-B51EB/XL). Also verified via BOM Explorer search API and UI directly for FMF519 (93 components), HTBS (60), NS-SPST2B (58) - all match expected values from the review request. bom-cache/stats returns ISO timestamps with '+00:00' suffix (confirming tz-aware datetimes now flow correctly). bom-cache/refresh completed cleanly ('failed': 0, no errors). No TypeError/'cant compare' errors appeared anywhere in backend logs after the fix-deploying restart.

issues: Uses native browser <input type='month'/'date'> control instead of a shadcn calendar/month-picker component - minor/pre-existing, not part of this fix, noting per design-review guidelines only.

critical_code_review_comments: Fix confirmed correct and minimal: server.py MongoClient now instantiated with tz_aware=True (line 31), matching the timezone-aware datetime.now(timezone.utc) writes - eliminates the naive/aware comparison TypeError at the root cause rather than patching symptoms.

Secondary fix (FETCH_RETRY_ATTEMPTS=3 retry-with-backoff in bom_cache_service._fetch_live) verified present and functioning - observed several genuine transient SAP ConnectTimeoutErrors being retried in logs during this session's live run, consistent with the documented known-flaky tenant behavior.

purchasing_plan.py's explode() broad try/except still silently swallows any future exception into a 'missing BOM' misreport without logging exception type/traceback detail beyond a WARNING message - acceptable given legitimate-missing-BOM is a valid business case, but if another root-cause class of error appears in future, it will again masquerade as 'No SAP BOM found'. Not required to fix now, but worth flagging as a design smell for main agent's awareness.

Verified log evidence directly: identical error message 'can't compare offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes' for FMF519/HTBS/NS-SPST2B/etc. appears only in log lines with timestamps BEFORE the backend process restart (uptime confirmed ~10min via supervisorctl), and does NOT reappear in any log line after the restart during this session's full live purchasing-plan generation + cache refresh run - strong positive confirmation the fix works, not just a hopeful re-run coincidence.
test_credentials: N/A - no app-level auth; SAP/OMS/Mongo creds used as-is from backend/.env per review request.
seed_data_creation: None - used live SAP/OMS data via default target month full purchasing-plan generation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix fully verified this session: (1) FMF519 (93 comp), HTBS (60 comp), NS-SPST2B (58 comp) all correctly resolve via both /api/bom/search and full /api/purchasing-plan/generate flow, absent from missing_boms. (2) Full plan run: total components=799, missing_boms=8 (7721622, 7770570, P392619, P392622, P392623, P392638, P392639, WMN-B51EB/XL) - these 8 are legitimate (no Production BOM in SAP per review request, purchased/trading parts), matches review request's expected numbers exactly. (3) /api/bom-cache/stats and /api/bom-cache/refresh regression-checked clean with tz-aware client (+00:00 suffix in ISO timestamps, refresh completed with failed:0). (4) Frontend BOM Explorer search UI regression-checked for FMF519 - renders correctly, no 'No SAP BOM found' false negative. Did not re-test Inventory Netting feature (iteration_20) per instructions since this fix is additive/corrective only and no netting-related code paths were touched or broke. No further action needed unless new symptoms surface.
rca_of_the_issue: Confirmed via direct log correlation: pre-fix backend log lines show 'purchasing_plan - WARNING - BOM explosion failed for SAP id FMF519/HTBS/NS-SPST2B/...: cant compare offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes' - all timestamped before the backend restart that deployed the tz_aware=True fix. Zero recurrences of this error class post-restart across a full live Purchasing Plan generation + cache refresh cycle in this session, confirming root cause correctly identified and resolved at the source (MongoClient construction) rather than patched downstream.
